summary: Create an HTTPS ClientRequest with Node TLS/socket semantics.

target.notes: Same ClientRequest stream model as http.request plus TLS certificate/SNI/ALPN/session behavior at a host/runtime boundary.

semantics.notes: Same ClientRequest stream model as http.request plus TLS certificate/SNI/ALPN/session behavior at a host/runtime boundary.

caveats: Preserve Node stream/EventEmitter, host ordering, header state, and network/TLS behavior rather than substituting unrelated .NET HTTP defaults.
